newsitem.title: USA: Synthetic Industries holder to offer shares.
newsitem.headline: Synthetic Industries holder to offer shares.

text.p: Synthetic Industries Inc on Monday said it filed a registration statement on behalf of its majority shareholder, Synthetic Industries LP, for a distribution of existing shares.
Synthetic Industries LP unit holders would have a chance to improve the liquidity of their holdings by receiving shares of publicly traded Synthetic Industries Inc over time, the company said.
Limited partners of Synthetic Industries LP would be able to receive some or all of the 5,781,250 shares held by the partnership, Synthetic Industries said.
The company produces polypropylene fabrics and fibers used in home furnishings, construction, filtration and environmental and agricultural applications.
Synthetic Industries said the underlying shares of the limited partners that opt to receive cash instead of stock would be issued in an underwritten secondary offering before January 1998.
Limited partnership holders electing to take Synthetic Industries common shares would receive the shares in one or more distribtions after the secondary offering, Synthetic Industries said.
